BROKEN_LOCAL_LINK.title: Broken local link
BROKEN_LOCAL_LINK.description: A relative or repository-root link points at a file or directory that does not exist.

BROKEN_ANCHOR.title: Broken heading anchor
BROKEN_ANCHOR.description: A #fragment does not match any heading or id/name attribute in the target Markdown file (GitHub slug rules).

PATH_CASE_MISMATCH.title: Link path differs in letter case
PATH_CASE_MISMATCH.description: The link resolves on case-insensitive filesystems (Windows/macOS) but breaks on Linux and GitHub.

UNDEFINED_REFERENCE.title: Undefined reference link
UNDEFINED_REFERENCE.description: A [text][label] reference has no matching [label]: url definition.

MALFORMED_LINK.title: Malformed link encoding
MALFORMED_LINK.description: The URL contains invalid percent-encoding or NUL characters.

UNSAFE_LINK_SCHEME.title: Unsafe URL scheme
UNSAFE_LINK_SCHEME.description: A link uses javascript:, file:, vbscript: or another non-web scheme.

OUTSIDE_REPOSITORY_LINK.title: Link escapes repository
OUTSIDE_REPOSITORY_LINK.description: A local link resolves outside the scanned root; it is reported and never opened.

IMAGE_MISSING_ALT.title: Image without alternative text
IMAGE_MISSING_ALT.description: Markdown or HTML image has no alt text (WCAG 1.1.1).

UNCLOSED_CODE_FENCE.title: Unclosed code fence
UNCLOSED_CODE_FENCE.description: A fenced code block is never closed, so everything after it renders as code.

CLI_UNKNOWN_SUBCOMMAND.title: Documented subcommand not in declared contract
CLI_UNKNOWN_SUBCOMMAND.description: A documented command uses a subcommand absent from the cliContracts you declared. The declaration itself may be stale.

CLI_UNKNOWN_FLAG.title: Documented flag not in declared contract
CLI_UNKNOWN_FLAG.description: A documented command uses a --flag absent from the cliContracts you declared. The declaration itself may be stale.

PIPE_TO_SHELL.title: Pipe-to-shell install pattern
PIPE_TO_SHELL.description: A snippet pipes a download straight into a shell (curl | sh). Never executed by DocSutra; flagged for manual review.

DESTRUCTIVE_COMMAND.title: Destructive command in docs
DESTRUCTIVE_COMMAND.description: A snippet contains a destructive command (rm -rf, mkfs, dd, chmod -R 777 ...). Never executed; flagged for manual review.

SECRET_IN_DOCS.title: Possible credential in documentation
SECRET_IN_DOCS.description: Text matches a known credential format (GitHub/npm/AWS/Slack/Stripe/Google tokens, private keys). The value is redacted in all reports.

DUPLICATE_HEADING.title: Duplicate heading in one file
DUPLICATE_HEADING.description: Duplicate headings get -1, -2 suffixed anchors, which makes anchor links fragile.

EMPTY_LINK_TEXT.title: Link with no text
EMPTY_LINK_TEXT.description: A link has an empty label, which is unusable for screen-reader users (WCAG 2.4.4).

HEADING_LEVEL_SKIP.title: Heading level skipped
HEADING_LEVEL_SKIP.description: A heading jumps more than one level (for example h2 to h4), which weakens document structure.

INVALID_FILE.title: Document could not be read as UTF-8 text
INVALID_FILE.description: The file contains invalid UTF-8 or a NUL byte and was not analysed.

limitations: External URLs are not fetched or checked.
Shell commands are statically classified and, if you declare cliContracts, compared to that declaration; no command or test is ever executed.

The scanner is a bounded Markdown scanner, not a full CommonMark/MDX parser; setext/ATX headings, fenced and indented code, code spans, comments, inline/reference links, images and HTML href/src are covered. Footnotes, MDX expressions and generated docs are not.
A CLI contract is a declaration you maintain; it can itself be stale. It is not runtime verification of the real CLI.
Secret detection uses high-precision formats only and cannot find arbitrary secrets.
An audit timestamp records when the check ran; it does not certify that documentation claims or API behaviour are true.
